'''Torrig Omal''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] competitive swimmer during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission" /> Around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "Crime Wave" was released with the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion, it must take place around that year as well.</ref> the [[Order of Shasa]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] sought to arrest them in connection to a series of [[Thief/Legends|thefts]] of [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]],<ref name="Mission" /> a medical substance,<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> on<ref name="Mission" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. The Order hired offworld investigators to locate Omal.<ref name="Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
Torrig Omal was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Crime Wave," released as part of the [[2014]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Mission" />
